[asseticon:stun] Stunned: Cannot act
[asseticon:petrified] Petrified: Cannot act. Gain 100 Ice and Lightning resist. Gain 75 Physical and Fire resist
[asseticon:glassed] Glassified: Cannot act. Gain 100 Ice and Lightning resist. Gain 75 Fire resist. Lose 100 Physical resist
[asseticon:sleep] Sleep: Cannot act. Ends upon taking any damage that is not Arcane or Dark
[asseticon:fear] Fear: Cannot willingly act. Each turn, automatically attempt to move away from enemies
[asseticon:frozen] Frozen: Cannot act. Ends upon taking Fire or Physical damage. 100 Ice resist prevents and cures freezing
[asseticon:poison] Poisoned: Take 1 Poison damage each turn and cannot heal. 100 Poison resist prevents and cures poison
[asseticon:bleed] Bleed: Take 3 Physical damage each turn. 100 Physical resist prevents and cures bleeding
[asseticon:necrosis] Necrosis: Lose 1 max HP each turn. 100 Dark resist prevents and cures necrosis
[asseticon:soaked] Soaked: Gain 50 Fire resist. Lose 50 Ice and Lightning resist
[asseticon:berserk] Berserked: Become hostile to all other units. May attack and be attacked by allies
[asseticon:immobile] Immobilized: Cannot walk
[asseticon:silence] Silenced: Cannot cast non-melee spells
[asseticon:blind] Blind: All spell ranges reduced to 1

[asseticon:quickcast] Quickcast: Casting spells uses only half of a turn
[asseticon:quickmove] Quickstep: Moving uses only half of a turn
[asseticon:channeling] Channeling: The spell's effect repeats on the same target until another action is taken
[asseticon:reincarnation] Reincarnate: On death, come back to life at a random location on the map with full HP
[asseticon:clarity] Clarity: Removes and prevents Stunned, Fear, Petrified, Glassified, Frozen, and Silenced

Up to 10 spells and 2 upgrades for each can be purchased with SP
Any number of equipments can be crafted using the components you find

Spells and Equipment are only affected by bonuses to attributes in their tooltips
Attribute bonuses come in the form of percent-based and flat bonuses, and are applied in that order

Spells and Equipment can be filtered using the provided filters and with the search function
Filters can be activated by clicking or SHIFT clicking the filter, or by using their hotkeys
You can begin searches with \ to search for exact phrasing, i.e. \ adds the fire tag

Selecting equipment you cannot craft marks it as desired and adds it to your character panel
Left Click a desired item or use SHIFT 1 - 3 to craft it if possible or remove it otherwise

When something says it casts a spell or gains a spell, it will use your version of that spell
Even if you don't own the spell in question, any relevant bonuses you have will be applied

Extra tooltips while examining Rifts and Components contain a Prospective Equipment page
Prospective Equipment cannot be crafted at that moment, but could if you had the component(s) in question

Each level, you can reroll rifts once, closing the existing rifts and opening new ones

Mastery is the sum total SP cost of spells you own with a given tag, including applied upgrades
Hover over a tag filter in the Spell or Equipment shop to see your current mastery for that tag
